content:
mira: Quick sync - we need a minimal handoff plan for Dedicated GA: tenant gating, provisioning API contract, and ops runbook. Keep pilot scope tiny. Can we list must-haves by EOD?
vanya-product: Must-haves: tenant tiers names, default quota slabs, and clear customer-comm matrix (what's guaranteed vs best-effort).
julie-eng: Engineering must-haves: reserve-slot flow for enterprise (fast path), token-bucket smoothing, and an emergency throttle switch. Keep carryover behind FF. ETA: 3w for smoothing prototype.
sam-ops: Ops needs telemetry (pool_util, queued_requests, reserve_count) + an oncall playbook for prewarm/drain. Also require a manual override API to flip emergency gate.
cheng: Technical constraints: carrying per-tenant balance increases control-plane load. Recommend deferring carryover to pilot customers only.
kevin-eng: Autoscale heuristic we propose: use moving-window p99 + utilization threshold, cooldown 3m, max 1 scale up per 2m. Also soft-headroom = 10% before billing burst.
acme-cs: Acme wants carryover for campaign windows; happy to be pilot. Need billing clarity.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: `dedicated/provisioning:v0.1-canary` at 04:00 UTC tomorrow.
mira: OK action list: product finalize tier names & comms, eng prototyping smoothing & manual gate, ops draft runbook + manual override API, cs enroll Acme for carryover pilot. We'll reconvene Thu 10am to confirm progress.
